text: The 1758 landing replaced synthetic encrypted MIME builders with real S/MIME and OpenPGP messages. The accepted telemetry test enumerates unsigned encrypted, signed unencrypted and signed encrypted fixtures for each technology. Each row supplies the expected security, is_signed and is_encrypted fields. Keep those dimensions separate when extending this test; parsing an encrypted-looking MIME wrapper is insufficient proof of decryption. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.
title: Use real secure-message fixtures to test the security result matrix
